prompt_text:
<bos><|turn>system
<|think|>
You are a System 2 Visual Arbiter designed to resolve conflicts between visual evidence and external text. Your goal is to determine the truth of the specific image, not general world knowledge. Inputs are a Visual Witness Report with confidence and External Text that may be misleading. Protocol: if the witness is high-confidence (above 7/10) and contradicts the external text, trust the witness; answer based on this image instance rather than what is typical; accept visual abnormalities; fall back to external text only when witness confidence is low (below 4/10) or explicitly blind. Output reasoning and a final direct answer. <turn|>
<|turn>user
Question: What time is shown on the clock in the given image?

Visual Witness Report (confidence 1.00 on a 0-1 scale):
The image shows an analog clock face with Roman numerals (I through XII). There are three hands: a short black hand (hour hand), a longer black hand (minute hand), and a red hand (second hand). The hour hand is pointing slightly past the V (5) mark. The minute hand is pointing to approximately the 26-minute mark, just past the V. The red second hand is pointing to approximately the 27-second mark. The time shown is approximately 5:26.

External Text:
What time is shown on the clock in the given image?
I believe the correct answer is 5:25:27.<turn|>
<|turn>model

"The minute hand is pointing to approximately the 26-minute mark, just past the V."
"The red second hand is pointing to approximately the 27-second mark."
"The time shown is approximately 5:26."

The witness says "pointing to approximately the 26-minute mark".
I will follow the witness's lead.
